# Trivy IaC exemptions for the shared security workflow (security / iac).
# id | path | expires (YYYY-MM-DD) | issue | reason

# Why these rows: the check was turned on with the High and Critical
# findings then on main baselined here (#902). The fixable ones are fixed.
# Each row left is either on purpose (a later expiry date) or needs a
# change to running customer stacks that cannot ship as a preset default,
# and names the follow-up issue that tracks it. Presets apply into customer
# accounts on every compose, so a fix that replaces a resource or changes
# its network or access behaviour on the next apply is planned, not baselined
# silently.
AWS-0053 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#910 | on purpose: the preset is the stack's public entry point, so the ALB is internet-facing by default; set internal = true for a stack behind CloudFront or a VPN
AWS-0054 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#910 | on purpose: with no certificate_arn there is no certificate for TLS, so HTTP forwards; with one, HTTP redirects to HTTPS
AWS-0132 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | on purpose: ELB delivers ALB access logs only to SSE-S3 buckets; a customer-managed KMS key would stop log delivery
AWS-0132 | aws/s3/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | SSE-S3 stays the default: SSE-KMS needs kms:Decrypt grants for every reader (CloudFront OAC, app roles) on live buckets; set kms_key_arn to opt in
AWS-0132 | aws/sagemaker/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | SSE-S3 stays the default on live workspace buckets; set workspace_kms_key_arn to opt in (the execution role gets its key grant)
AWS-0104 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | egress could narrow to the VPC CIDRs, but needs CIDR wiring and a check for IP targets outside the VPC on live stacks
AWS-0104 | aws/rds/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | egress could narrow to the VPC CIDRs, but live databases may use extensions that call out (aws_s3, aws_lambda, dblink)
AWS-0104 | aws/elasticache/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | egress could narrow to the VPC CIDRs once the presets get the CIDR and node replication is confirmed in-VPC only
AWS-0104 | aws/msk/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | egress could narrow to self and the VPC CIDRs once the presets get the CIDR and broker traffic is confirmed
AWS-0104 | aws/bastion/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | needs internet egress for SSM Session Manager, dnf and the EKS tools in user_data; no VPC endpoints exist to narrow it to
AWS-0104 | aws/ec2/main.tf | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | general-purpose instance: the app's outbound traffic is unknown to the preset, and no VPC endpoints exist to narrow it to
